title: 第11章 九转天雷诀第12章 引雷入体
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: 唐天被训斥的无言以对，凡爷说的很有道理。
“前世你便是用丹药提升修为，以至于潜力殆尽，给你重活一次的机会，你还要走老路，你是脑子秀逗了？”
凡爷丝毫不给面子，直接打击。
“可是晚辈实在是想不到什么办法，能够在一个月的时间，提升修为……”
唐天讷讷的说道。
修为提升不上去，一个月之后，与林逸尘一战就是送死。
凡爷冷笑一声，“提升修为固然重要，因为很多强大的战技功法，都是需要相对应的修为。
可夯实基础更加重要，万丈高楼平地起，若是没有扎实的基础，只是无根浮萍而已。
你若是还不长记性，这辈子或许还不如上一世！”
“凡爷教训的对，是小子鲁莽了。”
唐天诚恳的认错。
“你小子还算有自知之明，不要以为你现在到了随时可以突破的时候。
爷认为，你还可以再夯实夯实基础。”
凡爷的声音，带着一抹深不可测的感觉。
“还能夯实基础？”
唐天愣了愣，原本以为，打通了天罡地煞一百零八条隐脉之后，就已经傲视众多修者，基础自然扎实。
实在是想不出来，究竟还能如何做到。
“修者的身体就如同一个水桶，有多大的体积就能盛装多少水。
而越是牢固的话，就越经得住风吹雨打。
你打通了天罡地煞隐脉，肉身的基础才只是开始。
你没有强大的身体，又怎么能盛装强大的力量？”
说到修炼方面的问题，凡爷倒是很有耐心。
前一世，唐天一心炼制丹药，在修炼上，从来都没有去考虑研究过什么。
凡爷的话，让自己茅塞顿开。
“炼脉境、焚血境、锻骨境、藏府境、出窍境，这都是在不断强大肉身的过程。
在每一个境界，你做到肉身的极致，你才能走向巅峰。
小子，别怪爷没提醒你，你若是不好好修炼。
别说以后回去报仇，能在这个世界活多久，都是问题。”
凡爷冷笑连连。
“回去报仇……”
唐天又怎么会忘记，当初是怎么死的？
就因为他得到了黑塔，很多终身无法突破的强者对他出手，想要抢夺。
content_en:
"Uh..."
Tang Tian was speechless after being scolded, but what Master Fan said made sense.
"In your previous life, you used elixirs to improve your cultivation, so that your potential was exhausted. If you are given a chance to live again, you still want to follow the old path. Are you crazy?"
Mr. Fan didn't give any face and attacked directly.
"But this junior really can't think of any way to improve his cultivation level in one month..."
Tang Tian said nonchalantly.
If his cultivation level cannot be improved, a month later, he will die in a battle with Lin Yichen.
Fan Ye sneered, "It is important to improve your cultivation level, because many powerful combat techniques require corresponding cultivation levels.
But laying a solid foundation is even more important. If a tall building rises from the ground, without a solid foundation, it is nothing more than rootless duckweeds.
If you don’t have a long memory, this life may not be as good as the last one! "
"Master Fan is right to teach you a lesson, it's the boy who is being reckless."
Tang Tian sincerely admitted his mistake.
"You kid is quite self-aware, don't think that you can break through at any time now.
I think you can still lay a solid foundation. "
Fan Ye's voice had an unfathomable feeling.
"Can we still lay a solid foundation?"
Tang Tian was stunned. He originally thought that after opening up the 108 hidden veins of Tiangang Disha, he would already be superior to many cultivators, and his foundation would naturally be solid.
I really can't think of how else to do it.
“The body of a cultivator is like a bucket, it can hold as much water as its size.
And the stronger it is, the more it can withstand wind and rain.
You have opened up the Tiangang Disha Hidden Veins, and the foundation of the physical body is just the beginning.
If you don't have a strong body, how can you contain strong power? "
When it comes to cultivation issues, Mr. Fan is very patient.
In his previous life, Tang Tian focused on refining elixirs and never considered studying anything in his cultivation.
Fan Ye's words made me enlightened.
“Pulse Refining Realm, Blood Burning Realm, Bone Forging Realm, Zangfu Realm, and Out of the Orifice Realm are all processes of continuously strengthening the physical body.
In every realm, you can reach the peak only if you reach the extreme of your physical body.
Boy, don’t blame me for not reminding you, if you don’t practice well.
Not to mention going back for revenge in the future, how long you can survive in this world is still a question. "
Master Fan sneered again and again.
"Go back and take revenge..."
How could Tang Tian forget how he died in the first place?
Just because he got the Black Tower, many strong men who could never break through took action against him, trying to rob him.
